summary.text: John Curtis was sworn in as a U.S. Senator from Utah in 2025.

paragraphs.text: He was elected Mayor of Provo in 2009 and served two terms, then won a 2017 special election and was sworn in to Utah's 3rd congressional district on January 13, 2017.
A Salt Lake City native and BYU graduate, he co-built the company Action Target before entering public service, and lives in Provo.
